hook.en: Two identical products sit on a shelf. The one with the better logo, packaging and advert sells more. Design is a powerful business tool.
hook.bm: Dua produk yang sama berada di rak. Produk dengan logo, pembungkusan dan iklan yang lebih baik lebih laris. Reka bentuk ialah alat perniagaan yang berkuasa.

bigIdeas.en: Marketing is the process of identifying customer needs and promoting and selling products to meet them.
bigIdeas.bm: Pemasaran ialah proses mengenal pasti keperluan pelanggan serta mempromosi dan menjual produk untuk memenuhinya.

bigIdeas.en: Design attracts attention, builds brand identity and communicates a product's benefits.
bigIdeas.bm: Reka bentuk menarik perhatian, membina identiti jenama dan menyampaikan kelebihan produk.

bigIdeas.en: Advertising methods include posters, brochures, banners, social media, videos, websites and packaging; the right one depends on audience and cost.
bigIdeas.bm: Kaedah pengiklanan termasuk poster, risalah, kain rentang, media sosial, video, laman web dan pembungkusan; pilihannya bergantung pada khalayak dan kos.

detail.bm: Imej, warna atau tajuk yang menonjol.

detail.en: Show how it benefits the customer.
Tell them how to buy (call, scan, visit).

definition.en: Identifying customer needs and promoting and selling products.
definition.bm: Mengenal pasti keperluan pelanggan serta mempromosi dan menjual produk.

definition.en: The name, logo and image that identify a product or company.
definition.bm: Nama, logo dan imej yang mengenal pasti produk atau syarikat.

definition.en: The group of people an advert is aimed at.
definition.bm: Kumpulan orang yang menjadi sasaran iklan.

definition.en: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action — a model for effective adverts.
definition.bm: Perhatian, Minat, Keinginan, Tindakan — model iklan berkesan.

definition.en: Product, Price, Place, Promotion — the marketing mix.
definition.bm: Produk, Harga, Tempat, Promosi — campuran pemasaran.

question.en: Choose an advertising method for a student-made phone stand sold at the school carnival.
question.bm: Pilih kaedah pengiklanan untuk pemegang telefon buatan murid yang dijual di karnival sekolah.

steps.en: Audience: students, teachers and parents at school.
steps.bm: Khalayak: murid, guru dan ibu bapa di sekolah.

steps.en: Low budget, short period, local area.
steps.bm: Bajet rendah, tempoh singkat, kawasan setempat.

steps.en: Posters around school + a short video on the school social media page.
steps.bm: Poster di sekitar sekolah + video pendek di laman media sosial sekolah.

answer.en: Posters and social media — cheap, reaches the right audience, quick to produce.
answer.bm: Poster dan media sosial — murah, sampai kepada khalayak yang betul, cepat dihasilkan.
